summary: Full-stack testing of Medan (ميدان) Arabic RTL field-work management MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth (register/login/me), Arabic error messages, protected endpoints returning 401 without token, seed idempotency + expected counts (3 locations, 4 employees, 4 vehicles, 6 maintenance, 7 violations, 3 leaves), full CRUD, and all stats endpoints. Frontend: mobile viewport (390x844) — login screen renders with Arabic RTL, login with admin@medan.sa/admin123 succeeds and navigates to dashboard which shows KPIs (4/1/2/0), summary cards, bar chart (6 months with Arabic labels: يوليو..فبراير), pie chart with legend, upcoming maintenance alert, and maintenance cost (6,150 ر.س). Tab navigation works via expo-router hrefs (/vehicles /violations /employees). Vehicles tab shows 4 cards, filter chips active/maintenance/out_of_service work, add-vehicle FormSheet opens with plate/model fields. Violations tab shows 7 cards, line chart, paid/unpaid toggle. Employees tab shows 4 sub-tabs (employees/locations/leaves/maintenance) all switchable. Logout button reachable on dashboard. No red screen, no console errors (only benign 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning from expo-router).

issues: Bottom tab bar labels/icons overlap slightly with content on 390px viewport (see vehicles screenshot); tab labels appear cut off (last ~6px). Consider adding SafeAreaInsets bottom padding or increasing tabBarStyle height on Android/web.

react_native_issues.issue: Bottom tab-bar links have no testID; testing must use a[href='/vehicles'] etc. Consider adding tabBarButtonTestID or wrapping in tabBarButton with testID for better testability. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx

action_items: (Optional) Add testID to bottom Tab buttons via tabBarButton wrapper for more robust E2E testing.
(Optional) Address 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning — comes from expo-router/RN internals; can be ignored or LogBox-filtered (already is).
critical_code_review_comments: Solid: all MongoDB reads use projection {_id:0}; no ObjectId leaks.
Solid: JWT auth with bcrypt + Arabic error messages.
Solid: all interactive elements have testID.
Minor: dashboard.tsx uses Dimensions.get('window').width at module scope — doesn't react to window resize/rotate (fine for mobile-first).
Minor: violation-related endpoints do not restrict data per-user (single-tenant assumption); acceptable for MVP but should be noted for future multi-tenant.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI ≥0.100 in favor of lifespan; low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, dashboard KPIs+charts, vehicles CRUD entry, violations list+toggle, employees 4 sub-tabs, logout button reachable)

seed_data_creation: Seed already populated (3 locations, 4 employees, 4 vehicles, 6 maintenance, 7 violations, 3 leaves). Tests also verified /api/seed second call returns seeded=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds admin@medan.sa/admin123 confirmed working. Bottom tabs are expo-router Tabs without testIDs — use a[href='/vehicles'|'/violations'|'/employees'|'/dashboard'] as selectors. Sub-tabs inside employees screen have testID='tab-{employees|locations|leaves|maintenance}'.
